patch_description: The current algorithm routes every partition of every destination along the single cheapest Dijkstra path. This creates heavy congestion on shared links and ignores alternative low-cost routes. Improvement: for each (dst, partition) pair, pick from the k-shortest simple paths (by cost), cycling across them so partitions are spread over disjoint/diverse routes. This reduces redundant transfers on the same links, balances load across networks, and exploits multi-network topologies to lower total cost. Since cost likely depends on congestion/flow on edges, spreading partitions across parallel paths lowers per-edge flow and total cost.
